prompt_fields.subject: Shardskin: a great golden crystal formation grown into a living creature, a cluster of tall faceted amber-gold crystal shards with a brighter inner core and a few hovering splinters. Keep the native golden-amber colour and the faceted crystal anatomy.
prompt_fields.contrast: Taller than wide: a tall cluster whose central shard rises well above the rest, with the smaller shards stacked along it. Do not flatten the cluster into a low wide mound.
prompt_fields.composition: Full body, a tall standing crystal cluster seen from a front three-quarter angle, tallest shard at the top, smaller shards rising in a stepped spire. Overall height to width about 1.7 to 1.
prompt_fields.palette: amber and honey gold crystal with pale warm highlights and darker umber facets.
